facts.text: All undergraduate students complete the Wisdom Core curriculum, a 39-to-42 credit Jesuit course framework featuring a foundational Cornerstone Seminar.

sources.title: Wisdom Core Curriculum | Rockhurst University
sources.quote: The Wisdom Core curriculum consists of four components: Cornerstone Seminar, Foundation Courses, Keystone Designations and Threshold Experiences. Together, these will amount to 39-42 credit hours that will comprise the heart of your Jesuit education
